quotations.old_english: Gif ðú wile hál beón, drinc ðé gedeftlice
quotations.english: if thou wilt be healthy, drink in moderation

source_text: ge-deftlice; adv. Fitly, moderately; d&e-short;center :-- Gif ðú wile hál beón, drinc ðé gedeftlice if thou wilt be healthy, drink in moderation, Prov. Kmbl. 61. v. ge-dæftlíce.
